A1.justification: Both PDFs describe AtlasKV. The complete main texts and appendices are readable, and corresponding methods, equations, tables and figures can be matched reliably despite additions and renumbering.

before.justification: v1 reports original knowledge-grounding accuracy, generation-relevance scores, GPU-memory measurements, ablations and training-dynamics experiments.

after.justification: v2 retains those original experiments and adds relation-rewriting, injection-frequency, pruning-interaction, knowledge-coverage and inference-time results.

M1.justification: The proposed KG2KV pipeline, three-level HiKVP procedure, trainable projection heads and default architecture remain unchanged. Equation 7 explicitly documents the autoregressive objective; the new no-rewriting variants are component-removal ablations.

E1.justification: The training and evaluation corpora remain unchanged. Appendix B.5 adds an answer-availability scenario on ATLAS-CC-QKV and ATLAS-Pes2o-QKV: questions whose answers are absent from a smaller KG but present in a larger one. Dataset-label corrections from QA to QKV do not represent new datasets.

E2.justification: Table 2 adds CAG as a comparator in the analytical time-and-memory-complexity comparison. The empirical ICL, KBLaM and zero-shot comparisons remain unchanged; CAG receives no measured benchmark results. Newly cited E2GraphRAG and LinearRAG are discussed but not evaluated.

E3.justification: The added studies introduce substantial controlled protocols: removing rewriting separately during training and testing, varying injection frequency across K=1,3,10, jointly varying pruning thresholds, controlling answer availability across KG sizes, and measuring inference time. Appendix A's existing training budgets, encoders and evaluation defaults remain unchanged.

E4.justification: v2 adds rewriting ablations, injection-frequency sensitivity, inter-level pruning interactions, knowledge-coverage versus noise analysis, and HiKVP runtime-overhead analysis in Appendices B and F. The earlier entity-type, encoder, top-k and training-dynamics analyses are retained, including the relocated top-k study.

E5.justification: Appendix A.2 retains five random seeds and five scoring repetitions per seed, while Figure 5 retains standard-error shading. No changed run counts, uncertainty-estimation procedures, confidence intervals or significance tests are documented.

E6.justification: Existing benchmark values and retained plots are unchanged, but Tables 6–11 and Figure 6 add substantial results. For example, Table 7 reports ACC@1 of 26.9 without test-time rewriting versus 47.3 with rewriting for unpruned AtlasKV at 10,000 Pes2o triples. Table 11 reports 6.21 seconds with HiKVP versus 2.09 seconds without it at 10,000 triples.

T1.justification: Table 2 changes the RAG time expression from O(M+RT+(RT+N)^2) multiplied by D to O(M+RT+(RT+N)^2 multiplied by D), and adds CAG complexity expressions. The attention-equivalence and HiKVP complexity derivations in Appendices C–D remain unchanged apart from numbering.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction's contributions and conclusion retain the same claims: billion-scale KG augmentation below 20GB VRAM, sublinear complexity, strong grounding/generalization, and adaptation without retraining. New experiments support existing claims without redefining the central contribution.

C2.justification: The earlier accuracy–scalability discussion expands to CPU–GPU transfer latency and rewriting-cost trade-offs. New interpretations address injection frequency, pruning interactions and knowledge coverage. Appendix J explicitly acknowledges that flattening graph structure limits multi-hop reasoning, alongside pruning precision loss and system overhead.

D1.justification: Section 4.2 newly specifies the autoregressive training objective, and Appendix B documents preprocessing and parameter settings for the added studies. Existing hardware, precision, optimizer, training budgets, prompts and code/data links remain unchanged. The added timing experiment provides limited timing-protocol detail.

R1.justification: v2 adds CAG, E2GraphRAG and LinearRAG to the references and related-work discussion. It acknowledges efficient graph-retrieval developments and contrasts cached-context scaling with AtlasKV, while preserving its broader positioning relative to KBLaM and RAG.

P1.justification: Most existing prose and the main section order are preserved. Changes include an explicit objective explanation, acknowledgments, expanded Appendix B organization, subdivision of Appendix F, a new limitations section, corrected dataset terminology and an updated publication header.

P2.justification: Six new appendix tables and a four-panel injection-frequency figure substantially expand the displayed evidence, including shaded pruning-interaction matrices. Table 2 gains a CAG row. Existing figures, example tables and prompt boxes are retained, with relocation and renumbering rather than replacement.

improvement.justification: v2 strengthens validation through targeted ablations and improves candor by measuring HiKVP's latency overhead and acknowledging graph-structure and multi-hop limitations that v1 omitted. These additions better qualify the scalability argument. The gain remains limited by sparse timing details in Table 11 and Table 10's unexplained GPTScore scale relative to the existing 0–1 scoring convention.
